summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K reporting termination of a Purchase Agreement dated October 29, 2024 with Helena Global Investment Opportunities I LTD. and Focus Impact Sponsor, LLC. The ELOC Agreement allowed the Company to sell up to $300,000,000 of common shares at the lowest intraday price during three trading days following Helena's receipt of shares. The termination is effective June 3, 2026, with no stated break fee or consideration. No financial impact or regulatory clock is disclosed. Watch for funding alternatives or liquidity concerns.
